description: Liste des Instituts français et de leurs antennes is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires Etrangères (MEAE). This dataset contains the coordinates of the more than 100 French Institutes around the world, which together with 128 branches constitute the main instrument of the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs in the implementation of France’s external cultural policy. Coverage: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires Etrangères (MEAE). The portal shows the English title as "List of French Institutes and their antennae" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires Etrangères (MEAE). Its keywords include culture, institut-francais. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2016-03-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
